## Comparison operators and Booleans

```{python}
10 == 10
```

```{python}
type(10 == 10)
```

```{python}
type(True)
```

```{python}
type("True")
```

```{python}
True * 10
```

```{python}
"True" * 10
```

```{python}
10 == 11
```

```{python}
10 < 10
```

```{python}
10 < 11
```

```{python}
10 > 10
```

```{python}
10 > 9
```

```{python}
10 != 11
```

```{python}
10 != 10
```

```{python}
# Equality comparison operator, with variables.
my_number == my_other_number
```

```{python}
my_extra_number = 200

# Show the value of `my_extra_number`
my_extra_number
```

```{python}
my_number == my_extra_number
```

```{python}
is_true = my_number == my_other_number

is_true
```

```{python}
type(is_true)
```

```{python}
is_false = my_number == my_extra_number

is_false
```

```{python}
type(is_false)
```

```{python}
"This string is the same" == "This string is the same"
```

```{python}
"This string is the same" == "This string is NOT the same"
```

```{python}
type("This string is the same" == "This string is NOT the same")
```

## Changing Data Types

[Can be done with built-in functions]

```{python}
my_int = 10

my_int
```

```{python}
my_float = float(my_int)

my_float
```

```{python}
type(my_int)
```

```{python}
type(my_float)
```

```{python}
my_string = str(my_float)

my_string
```

```{python}
type(my_string)
```
